name: Supply-chain-hardened pipeline
problem: SBOM, signing, vulnerability gate, shown blocking a bad dependency.
limits: The vulnerable urllib3 version exists only as scanner metadata, never as installed/executed package code. Syft inventories it, cosign signs and verifies the actual SBOM using an ephemeral local key, and grype must return a vulnerability-threshold failure with matches. Private signing keys are temporary and are never committed. Local offline signing deliberately omits transparency-log upload; this demonstrates artifact integrity, not identity-backed production provenance. Grype database availability is required. See evidence/gate-failure.log, evidence/grype.json and evidence/verification.log. Reverify with .cache/bin/cosign verify-blob --key evidence/cosign.pub --signature evidence/sbom.sig --insecure-ignore-tlog evidence/sbom.cdx.json.
next: Add keyless CI identity, provenance attestations and a passing patched dependency comparison.
